name: STATUS

fields.name: N
fields.description: Negative: copies result bit 7. In signed two’s-complement arithmetic, 1 indicates a negative result.

fields.name: OV
fields.description: Overflow: the signed result is outside the 8-bit range −128 to 127.

fields.name: Z
fields.description: Zero: indicates whether the result is zero.

fields.name: DC
fields.description: Digit Carry: carry from bit 3 to bit 4. In subtraction, the borrow polarity is reversed.
values: Addition: 1 = Carry from the low four bits; 0 = no carry.
Subtraction: 0 = Borrow from the low four bits; 1 = no borrow.

fields.name: C
fields.description: Carry: carry out of bit 7. In subtraction, the borrow polarity is reversed. Through-Carry rotates also read and update this bit.

resets.condition: MCLR / Watchdog / RESET instruction / stack reset

notes: Writing STATUS with an instruction that updates flags does not behave like an ordinary byte write. For example, CLRF STATUS sets Z and leaves the other implemented flags unchanged.
description: Records arithmetic and logic flags. Only instructions that affect a flag update it.
example:
MOVLW 0xFF
ADDLW 0x01           ; WREG = 0x00; C=1, DC=1, Z=1, OV=0, N=0
MOVLW 0x7F
ADDLW 0x01           ; WREG = 0x80; C=0, DC=1, Z=0, OV=1, N=1

fields.name: RD

0 = Does not initiate an EEPROM read
